title: URL shortener
summary: Read-heavy: almost every request looks up a link.
description: People open short links far more often than they create them, and a few links are much more popular than the rest. Two services behind a load balancer look up links in a cache first, and in the database when the cache doesn't have them.
experiments: Press Space to run. At the default traffic everything copes, and the cache answers about half of the lookups.
Set Traffic to 1000%. Both services get busy and p99 climbs.
Select Shortener API · 2 and press K to take it down. The other service can't keep up on its own, and users start seeing errors.
Bring it back, then add a third service behind the load balancer and watch p99 come down.
Select Users and set Key popularity to Every key equally likely. With no popular links the cache's hit ratio collapses, and the database does more of the work.
